title: Power Pages: OpenID Connect sign-in accepts encrypted ID tokens
summary: Hold: the default is labelled unknown even though the roadmap explicitly says the capability is enabled for end users automatically. The documented controls and product licensing background are otherwise supported, with small corrections needed to the governance navigation, claims-mapping citation and past preview question.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Authentication governance is under Power Platform admin center > Manage > Products > Power Pages > Settings > Authentication.
claims.quote:
Under Authentication, select the authentication option you want to manage.
6. Select an environment, and then select Manage.
7. Choose the sites where makers can configure the authentication option.
claims.fix: Complete the location with the documented targeting steps: Manage > Products > Power Pages > Settings > Authentication > OpenID Connect > environment > Manage, then choose the site targeting option. The current path reaches the correct section but stops before the option and target selection.

Set the Registration claims mapping additional site setting; for example, firstname=given_name,lastname=family_name.
